import html from typing import List # Example template with placeholders for the post components. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The author's name. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string for the post, safely escaped to prevent XSS. """ # Escape all user-supplied content safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body) # Convert tags to a series of elements safe_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Format the template with sanitized values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
